verdict.language_detail: PML (Prague Markup Language) XML annotation layer — morphological data layer
verdict.provenance_detail: PDT/PCEDT morphological annotation layer (mdata) generated by automatic tagger for Czech WSJ translation corpus
verdict.purpose: Morphological annotation layer for Czech translation of WSJ article wsj0627, part of the Prague Czech-English Dependency Treebank (PCEDT). Contains per-token morphological tags (lemma, POS tag) with multiple hypotheses and recommended readings for each word token.
